sources.title: Randomized Benchmarking
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: IBM 拓樸映射：SWAP 額外成本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付比值推導、負估計反例及配對採樣計畫。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver the ratio derivation, a negative-estimate counterexample and paired sampling plan. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM 拓樸映射：SWAP 額外成本』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付連接圖、SWAP清單、末端置換及誤差帳。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM topology mapping: SWAP overhead', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a coupling graph, SWAP list, final permutation and error ledger.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：d=4時教學估計rG=(d−1)/d×(1−αI/αR)；參考與交錯噪聲假設須相容。 使用合成αR=0.990、αI=0.984，d=4；不將兩個α直接相減當門誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(3/4)*(1-0.984/0.990)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查αI=αR時估計為0；αI>αR的負值應被標記，不能解釋為超越完美門。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學將每SWAP分解成3個CX，附加生存率s=(1−pCX)^(3Nswap)；忽略相關錯誤與其他門。 使用合成Nswap=4、每CX錯誤pCX=0.01；僅比較路由額外開銷。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-0.01)**(3*4)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：逐條列出12與6個CX並直接連乘核對；確保最後的邏輯位元對應有追蹤。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For d=4 use teaching estimate rG=(d−1)/d×(1−αI/αR); reference and interleaved noise assumptions must be compatible. Use Synthetic αR=0.990, αI=0.984 and d=4; do not equate the raw α difference with gate error. Evaluate nominal expression (3/4)*(1-0.984/0.990) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check zero estimate when αI=αR; flag negative estimates for αI>αR rather than calling them better-than-perfect gates.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Model each SWAP as3 CX gates with additional survival s=(1−pCX)^(3Nswap); correlations and other gates are excluded. Use Synthetic Nswap=4 and pCX=0.01 per CX; compare routing overhead only. Evaluate nominal expression (1-0.01)**(3*4) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: List12 and6 CX gates and directly multiply; track final logical-to-physical correspondence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IonQ 螢光讀出：光子計數與可分辨度
related.titleEn: IonQ fluorescence readout: photon counting and separation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付比值推導、負估計反例及配對採樣計畫。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

Final handover must include: Deliver the ratio derivation, a negative-estimate counterexample and paired sampling plan. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IonQ 螢光讀出：光子計數與可分辨度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付計數分布、SNR換算及曝光／狀態穩定性取捨。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ fluorescence readout: photon counting and separation', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver count distributions, SNR calculations and exposure/state-stability tradeoffs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：d=4時教學估計rG=(d−1)/d×(1−αI/αR)；參考與交錯噪聲假設須相容。 使用合成αR=0.990、αI=0.984，d=4；不將兩個α直接相減當門誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(3/4)*(1-0.984/0.990)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查αI=αR時估計為0；αI>αR的負值應被標記，不能解釋為超越完美門。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：獨立Poisson計數的差分SNR=(Nb−Nd)/sqrt(Nb+Nd)；這不是最佳閾值的精確錯誤概率。 使用教學亮態Nb=25、暗態Nd=1個計數；相同曝光時間。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(25-1)/sqrt(25+1)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：分別列Poisson方差等於均值；若觀測方差大於均值，加入光源波動模型。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For d=4 use teaching estimate rG=(d−1)/d×(1−αI/αR); reference and interleaved noise assumptions must be compatible. Use Synthetic αR=0.990, αI=0.984 and d=4; do not equate the raw α difference with gate error. Evaluate nominal expression (3/4)*(1-0.984/0.990) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check zero estimate when αI=αR; flag negative estimates for αI>αR rather than calling them better-than-perfect gates.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For independent Poisson counts, difference SNR=(Nb−Nd)/sqrt(Nb+Nd); this is not the exact optimal-threshold error probability. Use Teaching bright count Nb=25 and dark count Nd=1 at equal exposure. Evaluate nominal expression (25-1)/sqrt(25+1) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: List Poisson variance equal to mean; if observed variance exceeds mean, add illumination-fluctuation modeling.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
